title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Build and evaluate machine learning models for search quality. Work with data pipelines, write reproducible experiments, and collaborate with engineers to deploy and monitor model performance.
rounds: Resume Screening → Coding Assessment → Machine Learning Interview → HR

title: Software Engineering Intern
description: Join a product engineering team to implement backend features, write automated tests, and review code with an assigned mentor. The internship includes a scoped project and regular technical feedback.
rounds: Online Coding Test → Technical Interview → Team Discussion

title: Data Analytics Intern
description: Clean operational datasets, create weekly reporting dashboards, and investigate changes in product metrics. Present findings with clear assumptions and validated data to the analytics team.
rounds: Resume Screening → SQL Assessment → Analytics Case Interview

title: Cloud Support Engineer
description: Troubleshoot cloud infrastructure incidents, reproduce customer issues, and document practical resolutions. Collaborate with engineering teams to improve service reliability and support tooling.
rounds: Aptitude Test → Linux and Networking Interview → HR

title: Frontend Developer
description: Develop accessible and responsive interfaces for internal productivity tools. Integrate APIs, maintain component tests, and work with designers to improve usability and page performance.
rounds: Frontend Coding Test → React Interview → Design Discussion → HR

title: Product Operations Intern

rounds: Resume Screening → Operations Case Study → HR
rejectionRemark: Please clarify the working hours and provide a named internship mentor before resubmitting this opportunity.
